messages.subject: Global Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Commodities Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Brad,

Proco Group's executive-search work across global commodities, metals, energy and low-carbon markets aligns strongly with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where resources and commodities growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
